documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Proceeding Of Extra Ordinary General Meeting
CORRIGENDUM CUM ADDENDUM TO THE NOTICE OF THE EXTRA-ORDINARY GENERAL MEETING

analysis.summary: Management reported strong financial and operational progress for FY 2025-26, driven by higher interest income, revenue growth, and expanding lending operations across core segments and new initiatives. Total revenue from operations reached ₹16,164.13 lakhs with profit before tax rising significantly to ₹6,664.38 lakhs, while the lending portfolio expanded to ₹35,652.97 lakhs. The company diversified its product offerings by introducing Equipment Financing under the "GrowU.money" brand and small ticket personal and business loans in partnership with Fintech Cloud Private Limited under the "Fundobaba" brand. Management remains optimistic about the long-term outlook of the Indian economy and the NBFC sector, though it continues to monitor credit, liquidity, and competitive risks. U.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the Indian economy maintained strong growth momentum during FY 2025-26 supported by consumption, investment, manufacturing, and services.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian economy maintained strong growth momentum during FY 2025-26, supported by domestic consumption, investment activity, manufacturing and services.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that increasing formalisation, financial inclusion, digitalisation, and growing organised credit demand create significant opportunities for NBFCs.
demand_outlook.quote: Increasing formalisation of the economy, financial inclusion, digitalisation and growing demand for organised credit have created significant opportunities for NBFCs.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the industry continues to face challenges regarding asset quality, competition, funding conditions, interest-rate movements, and regulatory environment.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, the industry continues to face challenges relating to asset quality, competition, funding conditions, interest-rate movements and an evolving regulatory environment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the growing financing requirements of businesses and individuals, increasing financial inclusion, and digital adoption provide a strong foundation for future financial intermediation.
demand_outlook.quote: The growing financing requirements of businesses and individuals, increasing financial inclusion, digital adoption and the continuing formalisation of economic activity provide a strong foundation for the future of financial intermediation.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects the operating environment to remain competitive and subject to evolving regulations, credit risks, interest-rate movements, and economic cycle changes.
demand_outlook.quote: However, we also recognise that the operating environment will remain competitive and subject to evolving regulations, credit risks, interest-rate movements and changes in the broader economic cycle.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the outlook of the business is very exciting and offers an opportunity to do something unique and exceptional.
demand_outlook.quote: The outlook of the business is very exciting and we take it as an opportunity to do something unique and exceptional.

demand_outlook.claim: The company noted that emerging markets in Asia maintained better economic momentum driven by domestic demand and technology sector growth.
demand_outlook.quote: While advanced economies like the U.S. and the Eurozone experienced slower growth due to high interest rates and weakened consumer spending, emerging markets, particularly in Asia, maintained better economic momentum, driven by domestic demand and technology sector growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that demand for credit is likely to remain strong, especially among MSMEs and retail, and is projected to grow by 13.5-14.0 per cent.
demand_outlook.quote: As the country progresses, demand for credit is likely to remain strong, especially among Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) and retail, and is projected to grow by 13.5-14.0 per cent.

capex_expansion.claim: The company introduced Equipment Financing under the "GrowU.money" brand during FY 2025-26 to diversify its product portfolio.
capex_expansion.quote: During FY 2025-26, we further diversified our product portfolio by introducing Equipment Financing under the “GrowU.money” brand.

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into a contractual joint venture agreement with Fintech Cloud Private Limited on April 9, 2025, for small ticket personal and business loans under the "FUNDOBABA" brand.
capex_expansion.quote: During the period under review, the Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on 9th April, 2025, inter alia considered and approved the contractual joint venture agreement dated 9th April, 2025 entered into by the Company with Fintech Cloud Private Limited (FCPL) for expansion of its business into the field on small ticket size Personal and Business Loan under its new brand name “FUNDOBABA”.

capex_expansion.claim: Management intends to expand operations in existing markets, selectively enter newer geographies, and explore organic and inorganic opportunities.
capex_expansion.quote: We intend to build upon our existing strengths by expanding our operations in existing markets, selectively entering newer geographies and exploring organic as well as inorganic opportunities, while remaining within our risk appetite.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved the opening of a new branch office at Lucknow for business expansion under the brand name GrowU.Money.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year under review, the Board of Directors at its meeting held on 3rd May, 2024 inter alia considered and approved the proposal of opening of the Company’s new branch office at Lucknow for the purpose of expansion of its business operation in the area of Lucknow under the brand name “GrowU.Money”.

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into a contractual joint venture agreement with Fintech Cloud Private Limited for business expansion into small ticket size personal and business loans under the brand name FUNDOBABA.
capex_expansion.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on 9th April, 2025, inter alia considered and approved the contractual joint venture agreement dated 9th April, 2025 entered into by the Company with Fintech Cloud Private Limited (FCPL) for expansion of its business into the field on small ticket size Personal and Business Loan under its new brand name “FUNDOBABA”.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its operations further into central and eastern Uttar Pradesh covering Prayagraj, Varanasi, Sonbhadra, Ayodhya, Deoria, and Gorakhpur regions.
capex_expansion.quote: After GrowU has received positive response in the areas of and Kanpur and Lucknow, it is now inter alia expanding further into central and eastern Uttar Pradesh covering Prayagraj, Varanasi, Sonbhadra, Ayodhya, Deoria and Gorakhpur regions.

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into various Business Correspondent Agreements for the expansion of its business.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company had also entered into various Business Correspondent Agreements for expansion of its business.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to enter new geographical markets and diversify service offerings.
capex_expansion.quote: Expansion into New Markets: Plans to enter new geographical markets and diversify service offerings are likely to open up new revenue streams.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations increased to ₹16,164.13 lakhs in FY 2025-26 compared to ₹11,104.61 lakhs in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: During the year under review, the Company achieved Revenue from Operations of ₹16,164.13 Lakhs, as against ₹11,104.61 Lakhs in the previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Profit Before Tax increased substantially to ₹6,664.38 lakhs for FY 2025-26 from ₹1,693.88 lakhs in FY 2024-25.
margins_costs.quote: Profit Before Tax increased substantially to ₹6,664.38 Lakhs, compared with ₹1,693.88 Lakhs in FY 2024-25.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations increased by 45.56% due to an increase in interest income in comparison with the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: This represents an increase of ` 5,059.52 lakhs, or 45.56% for the said period. The company experienced increase in the revenue from operations because of its increase in the interest income in comparison with the previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that inflationary pressures eased in most economies through the course of the year.
margins_costs.quote: Inflationary pressures eased in most economies through the course of the year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's lending portfolio expanded to ₹35,652.97 lakhs as at March 31, 2026, compared with ₹27,457.34 lakhs as at March 31, 2025.
orders_capacity.quote: Our lending portfolio also expanded meaningfully during the year, reaching ₹35,652.97 Lakhs as at March 31, 2026, compared with ₹27,457.34 Lakhs as at March 31, 2025.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has disbursed loans to more than 18,000 customers across India.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company has disbursed loans to more than 18,000 customers across India.

orders_capacity.claim: The company disbursed loans to more than 3,800 customers across customer locations in Uttar Pradesh through its network of 2 branches and 6 business correspondents.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company had disbursed loan to more than 3,800 customers, across more than 2 Customer Locations in Uttar Pradesh, through its network of 2 branches, & 6 Business Correspondents.

orders_capacity.claim: The company ended the year with the highest ever disbursements and portfolio size.
orders_capacity.quote: The year 2023-24 has been a great one for us, as we ended the year with the highest ever disbursements and portfolio size, with the fully capacitized and diverse management team by Company's expansion into central and eastern Uttar Pradesh and many more.

orders_capacity.claim: The company built a loan portfolio exceeding 14 crore INR while keeping the NPA rate below 2 percent.
orders_capacity.quote: Loan Portfolio Expansion: In just one year, Company has built a loan portfolio exceeding 14 crore INR keeping the NPA rate below 2 percent.

capital_allocation.claim: The Directors did not recommend any dividend for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, to plough back resources for future growth.
capital_allocation.quote: The Directors of your Company do not recommend any dividend for the financial year ended 31st March, 2026 in order to plough back the resources for future growth.

capital_allocation.claim: The paid-up equity share capital as on March 31, 2026, was ₹9,511.92 lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: The paid up equity share capital as on 31st March 2026 was ` 9,511.92 Lakhs.

capital_allocation.claim: The company received in-principle approval from BSE and NSE on July 15, 2025, for a proposed private placement of equity shares through Qualified Institutional Placements up to ₹50 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: However, the Company has received in-principle approval from the BSE Limited and NSE Limited both dated 15th July, 2025 under Regulation 28(1) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 for the proposed private placement of equity shares face value of Rs. 5/- each, total amount to be raised not exceeding Rs. 50 Crores through Qualified Institutional Placements.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that the global environment was characterised by geopolitical tensions, changing trade policies, commodity price volatility, elevated global debt, and international financial market uncertainty.
risks_headwinds.quote: The year under review was characterised by a rapidly evolving global economic environment. Geopolitical tensions, changing trade policies, commodity price volatility, elevated global debt and uncertainty in international financial markets continued to influence economic activity across regions.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted credit and asset quality risk as a threat where borrower repayment capacity deterioration can increase credit costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Credit and Asset Quality Risk: Any deterioration in borrowers repayment capacity or economic conditions may adversely affect asset quality and increase credit costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted funding and interest-rate risk where changes in interest rates and liquidity conditions may affect borrowing costs, margins, and profitability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Funding and Interest-Rate Risk: Changes in interest rates, liquidity conditions and availability of funding may affect borrowing costs, margins and profitability.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that the global economy demonstrated modest growth amid ongoing geopolitical tensions, persistent inflationary pressures, and monetary policy adjustments.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the FY 2024-25, the global economy demonstrated modest growth amid ongoing geopolitical tensions, persistent inflationary pressures, and monetary policy adjustments.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that new tariff measures announced by the Trump administration heightened uncertainties surrounding the global economic outlook.
risks_headwinds.quote: The outlook has weakened further after January 2025, pursuant to the announcement of a series of new tariff measures by the Trump administration in the United States and counter measures by its trading partners.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global economic uncertainty continues due to factors like ongoing geopolitical conflicts, widespread elevation of debt, extreme weather conditions, and elections.
risks_headwinds.quote: Multiple factors like the on-going geopolitical conflicts, wide-spread elevation of debt, extreme weather conditions and elections in many parts of the world continue to contribute to the uncertainty of the Global Economic Outlook.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to expand its operations in existing markets, selectively enter newer geographies, and explore organic and inorganic opportunities.
management_commitments.quote: We intend to build upon our existing strengths by expanding our operations in existing markets, selectively entering newer geographies and exploring organic as well as inorganic opportunities, while remaining within our risk appetite.

management_commitments.claim: Management commits to focus on strengthening asset quality, maintaining adequate liquidity, improving operational efficiency, diversifying products, and expanding customer reach.
management_commitments.quote: We will continue to focus on strengthening our asset quality, maintaining adequate liquidity, improving operational efficiency, diversifying our products and expanding our customer reach.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to continue its efforts of mainstreaming financial inclusion and providing affordable credit to customers in the lower half of the socio-economic pyramid.
management_commitments.quote: The Company intends to continue its efforts of mainstreaming financial inclusion and providing affordable credit to customers in the lower half of the socio-economic pyramid.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to launch a new product involving loans against property.
management_commitments.quote: New Product Launch: To further diversify its offerings, the Company is set to launch a new product – loans against property.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
